_about: Clinic v2 prototype (docs/modes/clinic-v2-design-sheets.md part A): the approved backgrounds (sources/art/clinic-v2/, cut to webp in assets/clinic/rooms/) shown at full strength, and where the stand-in pieces stand on them. Every x/y is a share of the picture (1536 x 1024, aspect 1.5): x across, y down; a person's y is where their feet (or stool) meet the floor; h is their height as a share of the picture's height. `need` = the x-range that must stay on screen (the scene box covers the play area when it can; when the play area is too narrow for `need`, the box fits `need`'s width and sits on the bottom, and a soft mirrored strip of the wall fills above it). Placement checked against build/reports/clinic-bg-check/ (VISUAL-QA 2b).

waiting._about: The six-seat bench (cushion centres), the standing spots by the doctor's door and the desk, and a third standing spot by the window (level 5: 9 people; two little stools in front were tried and hid the bench's ticks). adult = an adult's height sitting (a child is `child` of it); the heart poster's frame ends at y 0.31, so a sitting adult's head (0.745 - 0.36 = 0.385) stays under it (the bg-check note).

exam._about: CB2b: the patient sits on the bed's edge (the mattress top at y 0.53, the step stool's top at 0.66, the floor at 0.8), facing us; the stand-in doctor stands to the right, turned 3/4. fig = the figure's box (the patient DOM figure draws seated inside it, feet at its bottom).

stand._about: CB3b: the patient stands on the floor in front of the plain wall between the anatomy poster and the height chart; the doctor to the right.

pharmacy._about: CB4c: the painted belt's surface runs edge to edge between y 0.615 and 0.69; items stand on it (their base at `beltY`, `itemH` tall); the counter strip in front (y 0.73 to 1) holds the pantry-style tray.

door._about: CB5: the patient stands on the doormat by the half-open front door; the doctor beside them, to the left (turned towards them). The four cards (or what helps) sit on the floor strip.
